testcase: IN-list covered by two different partial indexes uses a UnionScan

explain.statement: SELECT true AS present FROM $explan AS p WHERE ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'UnionScan' AND ARRAY_LENGTH(v.scans) = 2 AND ANY v1 WITHIN v.scans SATISFIES v1.`#operator` LIKE 'IndexScan%' AND v1.`index` = 'ix_pu_fr' END AND ANY v2 WITHIN v.scans SATISFIES v2.`#operator` LIKE 'IndexScan%' AND v2.`index` = 'ix_pu_us' END END AND NOT (ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'PrimaryScan3' END)

statements: SELECT pu_city, pu_country FROM shellTest WHERE pu_city LIKE "A%" AND pu_country IN ["France", "United States"] ORDER BY pu_country, pu_city

testcase: Equivalent OR form still uses a UnionScan

explain.statement: SELECT true AS present FROM $explan AS p WHERE ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'UnionScan' AND ARRAY_LENGTH(v.scans) = 2 AND ANY v1 WITHIN v.scans SATISFIES v1.`#operator` LIKE 'IndexScan%' AND v1.`index` = 'ix_pu_fr' END AND ANY v2 WITHIN v.scans SATISFIES v2.`#operator` LIKE 'IndexScan%' AND v2.`index` = 'ix_pu_us' END END AND NOT (ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'PrimaryScan3' END)

statements: SELECT pu_city, pu_country FROM shellTest WHERE pu_city LIKE "A%" AND (pu_country = "France" OR pu_country = "United States") ORDER BY pu_country, pu_city

testcase: IN-list with an uncovered value falls back to a primary scan

explain.statement: SELECT true AS present FROM $explan AS p WHERE ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'PrimaryScan3' END AND NOT (ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'UnionScan' END)

statements: SELECT pu_city, pu_country FROM shellTest WHERE pu_city LIKE "A%" AND pu_country IN ["France", "United States", "Germany"] ORDER BY pu_country, pu_city
